entries.final_answer: Drop the field entirely. actor already carries the harness key, the issue pre-authorises the drop, and any replacement token derived from a model id is the same identifier wearing a hat. Consequence handled explicitly: the claim cannot assert --model from the Op, so the resolved-binding model slot becomes explicit-absent (RESOLVED_MODEL_ABSENT) rather than fabricated.
options: Replace with an opaque non-identifying token

entries.final_answer: Configured commit.co_author in .kittify/config.yaml plus a per-close override (executor argument, exposed as profile-invocation complete --co-author). The standing configuration is what the issue asks for (no per-session hand work); the override covers harnesses whose operator identity is not in the project config, and gives the tests a second path that proves precedence.
